descriptionHtml:
AutoPerformance was founded in Vellinge, Sweden in 2002. In that time we have earned such a good reputation in our home market that now we don't only benefit from it, but we are also obligated to uphold it, every day anew.

We deliver the highest quality cars, combined with a no-fuss, peace-of-mind transaction.
Try us! -- Kristoffer & Andreas. We speak English, Deutsch, Svenska and Dansk.
This BMW M440i xDrive Convertible is available immediately and delivered directly to your door if you wish.

Highlights
• 374 hp Petrol Engine
• xDrive All-Wheel Drive
• Convertible
• 19" Alloy Wheels
• Electrically Deployable Tow Bar
• Navigation System
• Harman/Kardon Premium Sound System
• Heated Front Seats with Memory
• Heated Steering Wheel
• Airscarf Neck-Level Heating
• Head-Up Display
• Adaptive Cruise Control
• Blind Spot Assistant
• BMW Laserlight Headlights
• Parking Plus with Rear Camera
• Drive Recorder
• Driving Assistant Plus
• Wireless Smartphone Charging
• Apple CarPlay
• Android Auto

Additional Equipment
• Belt Extenders
• Digital Driver Display
• Automatically Dimming Rearview Mirror
• Electric Windows
• Electric Mirrors
• Remote Central Locking
• Trip Computer
• Bluetooth Media & Telephone
• Multifunction Steering Wheel with Paddle Shifters
• 2-Zone Climate Control
• Ambient Interior Lighting
• Electrically Folding Mirrors
• Comfort Access
• Keyless Go
• Isofix
• PDC (Park Distance Control)
• Exterior Courtesy Lighting
• Windscreen Display
• Active Protection

• Lane Departure Warning

• WiFi Hotspot
• Tanzanite Blue Metallic Paint
• Vernasca Oyster Leather Interior


No accidents, to the best of our knowledge.

We will be happy to deliver it right to your door, Europe-wide. Ask us for a quote!
